data.name: Rashid
data.gender_notes: Rashid is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ش-د (r-sh-d), 'to be rightly guided'. Rashīd means 'rightly guided'. Its root is ر-ش-د (r-sh-d). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Rashīd). Rashid is a Arabic name meaning “Rightly guided; mature; sensible”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rashid expresses “Rightly guided; mature; sensible”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ش-د (r-sh-d), 'to be rightly guided'. Rashīd means 'rightly guided'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rashid total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
